vwap.beginner_summary: The true volume-weighted average price paid by investors today. Prices above this line indicate buyers are in control.
vwap.risk_tip: Buying far above the average price increases your risk of buying at an overstretched top.

ema.beginner_summary: A 20-period moving average curve showing whether the overall price trend is heading up or down.
ema.risk_tip: Moving averages lag behind the real-time market price.

ohlcv.beginner_summary: Open, High, Low, Close price and Total Volume data for each trading session.
ohlcv.risk_tip: Historical price patterns provide context but cannot predict unpredictable future events.

rsi.beginner_summary: Measures how fast a stock is rising or falling on a scale of 0 to 100. Over 70 indicates overheated; under 30 indicates heavily sold.
rsi.risk_tip: Oversold does not guarantee an immediate bounce. In strong downtrends, prices can stay oversold for weeks.

bollinger_bands.beginner_summary: An envelope showing where prices trade 95% of the time. Prices touching the outer bands are at statistical extremes.
bollinger_bands.risk_tip: When bands contract tightly, an explosive price breakout in either direction is usually imminent.

macd.beginner_summary: Shows the relationship between short-term and long-term moving averages to detect momentum shifts.
macd.risk_tip: Can produce false whipsaws in choppy, sideways markets.

atr.beginner_summary: Measures how much the stock price typically swings in a day, helping set disciplined stop losses.
atr.risk_tip: High ATR means high volatility and larger potential losses if trades move against you.
